Name: Limited Campfire Cooking
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets you cook a configurable selection of recipes at campfires, including support for custom recipes.

What's cozier than bundling up next to the fire, roasting some hazelnuts?


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
Interact with a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Campfire]campfire[/url] to bring up the cooking menu with a limited selection of recipes suitable for cooking over an open flame (mostly soups).

You can optionally open the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file (which is generated when you run the game with the mod) in a text editor to enable all recipes or edit the list of available recipes. Vanilla and custom recipes can both be added by name.


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no changes to your save.[/quote]
